learner_operation: Simplify a square root or fraction or recognize finite-decimal/pi irrationality; determine integrality, rationality and sign; interpret +, -, and zero subscripts; check each candidate membership or universal containment; report the exact subset using the supplied radio bank or independent checkboxes.

fixed_features.feature: Four taught candidate number sets; elementary real-number inputs or universal named target set
fixed_features.justification: All captured problems evaluate four mathematical sets; tutorials 8214/8215 define hierarchy and sign/zero notation. Four is an appropriate workload constraint; which four sets qualify is not fixed.

fixed_features.feature: Positive naturals exclude zero; strict +/- excludes zero unless 0 is subscripted
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial 8214 explicitly excludes zero from N; tutorial 8215 explicitly defines strict sign and inclusive zero restrictions.

answer_roles.role: Target sign/type/zero or universal target class
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Change within taught elementary forms and named sets; rederive every truth and explanation. Magnitude changes within one class may preserve answers.
answer_roles.observed: All seven number categories and multiple universal targets occur; terminating-decimal production is absent.

answer_roles.role: Candidate set base, sign and zero restriction
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any four distinct taught candidates; each slot can qualify or not when feasible.
answer_roles.observed: Sampled across 18 symbols; all 16 ordinary truth patterns survive delivery. Source radio banks and three visible None options are not faithfully replayed.

answer_roles.role: Number and positions of qualifying sets; explicit None truth
answer_roles.eligible_variation: 0 through 4 ordinary matches; None iff zero matches. Position should not determine correctness.
answer_roles.observed: All counts and truth patterns vary; explicit None is correctly keyed, but zero-match solutions still instruct all unchecked.

coverage.case: Fresh production before and after actual delivery
coverage.result: 100 raw -> 94 accepted; six semantic duplicates removed. All five implemented profiles, counts 0..4, and 16 truth patterns survive; 23 stale solutions survive.
5 -> 5 accepted, five distinct truth patterns, ordinary counts 0,1,2,3. Item 1 has stale None solution. No all-batch constant response succeeds.
Three replay banks omit visible None; q-36246 is missing. Production offers neither terminating decimals nor radio banks.

counterfactuals.expected: N/Z/Q flip true to false; R stays true; prompt, explanation and grader follow.
counterfactuals.observed: All expected changes confirmed by exact math, native grading, and rendered prompts/solutions.
counterfactuals.justification: Square versus nonsquare root changes integrality/rationality, as sqrt(121) and sqrt(2) source cases establish.

counterfactuals.expected: Numeral and simplification change; membership vector stays true,true,true,true,false.
counterfactuals.observed: Magnitude and explanation update; same complete answer accepted, opposites rejected by actual grader; both rendered.
counterfactuals.justification: Both are positive integers, so magnitude is irrelevant to taught sign/type membership.

counterfactuals.change: all natural numbers -> all negative integers, fixed N,Z,Q-,R
counterfactuals.expected: N flips true->false, Q- flips false->true, Z/R unchanged; explanation counterexamples follow target.
counterfactuals.observed: Prompt, key, per-set explanations, rendered output and grader match.
counterfactuals.justification: Both classes occur in original sources and universal containment depends on the class, not its name alone.

counterfactuals.expected: Z+ and N become false; None becomes true and solution must say to select None.
counterfactuals.observed: Keys and native grader change correctly, but zero solution says leave every box unchecked; strict regression fails.
counterfactuals.justification: Zero exclusion is explicit in tutorials; source f51862bd uses visible None for zero qualifying candidates.
